# VoidFiller

VoidFiller is a technology‑focused Minecraft mod built with an engineering‑driven approach to architecture, system design, and scalability.

The mod introduces a modular ecosystem of machines, energy systems, materials, and progression, forming a foundation for future technological expansion.

---

# Vision

The goal of VoidFiller is to explore and implement:

•     Scalable and clean Minecraft mod architecture

•     A custom energy system (Void Energy)

•     Machine and pipe infrastructure

•     Expandable material and progression systems

•     Modular and extensible design principles

•     Support for additional mechanics (structures, mobs, world generation)

VoidFiller is developed as an engineering‑oriented pet project / portfolio project.

---

# ⚙ Core Features

## Machines & Systems

•     Void Generator — produces Void Energy

•     Void Extractor — extracts energy from the environment

•     Void Energy Pipe — transports energy (chorus‑style model)

•     Void Block / Solid Void — unique materials with special properties

## Materials & Items

•     Void Resin

•     Bedrock Shard

•     Void Alloy

•     Void Ingot

## Equipment

•     Void Armor Set

•     Void Toolset (sword, pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe)

---

# 🚀 Getting Started

## Requirements

•     Minecraft 1.21.1

•     NeoForge 21.1.218

•     Java 21

## Installation

1.     Download the mod from the Files or Releases section
2.     Place the  file into your  folder
3.     Launch Minecraft through NeoForge

---

## 🛠 Technology Stack

•     Language: Java

•     Modding API: NeoForge

•     Build System: Gradle

•     IDE: IntelliJ IDEA

•     Version Control: Git + GitHub

---

# 🎨 Assets & Legal Notice

The project currently uses fully original assets created specifically for VoidFiller.
